name: invite-accept-card
title: Invite accept card
description: A team invite as a card: the workspace, who invited you and as what, a role you can hover for its powers, and one-click join or a short sign-up form.
docs: workspace is { name, logo?, members? } and inviter is { name, email?, avatar? }; role is the word, and roleSummary the lines of what that role can do, which become a tooltip on the role chip (on hover, on focus and on a tap) and a hidden description for screen readers, so nobody joins blind. expiresAt says how long the invite stays good (Expires in 5 days, and the date, written with locale and timeZone, default en-US and UTC); pass now for the server HTML and tests, or leave it out and the card reads the clock once after the first paint. Once the date has passed the card says so and names who to ask, with no buttons. mode existing joins with the signed-in address: Join and Decline, plus Not you? (onSwitchAccount). mode new asks for a name and a password with its rules (rules) and calls onAccept({ name, password }); the address the invite went to is fixed in the form, and onSwitchAccount becomes Already have an account? Sign in. onAccept returns an error message or nothing; while either button works the other one waits, and the button that was pressed keeps the focus, so a failed try is one more press away. Once joined the card is finished: the button stays a solid Joined, the fields turn read-only, Decline, Not you? and Sign in stop working and the expiry line goes (it goes after a decline too, and the notice then takes the focus). A long workspace name wraps in the heading and on the Join button instead of stretching the card. Decline (onDecline) asks a small confirmation first. defaultOutcome starts on joined or declined for a preview; footer, titleAs, locale, timeZone and labels as in the other cards.
